intro: Buy more evidence, add fault probes, or compare models. Each action writes a new experiment, freezes it and starts it as a background job.

job.notStarted: Frozen, not started: start it from its page.

extend.title: Extend
extend.description: Add trials or tasks to firm up an unclear result.
extend.sizing: Suggested: about {{tasks}} more tasks to reach {{target}} pp.
extend.already: This experiment is itself a follow-up of {{expId}}. Extend the first experiment instead.
extend.trials: More trials of the same tasks
extend.tasks: Tasks this experiment did not run
extend.force: Extend anyway (the verdict is not inconclusive)
extend.confirm: Start a follow-up experiment of {{expId}}? It spends model budget.
extend.notInconclusive: The verdict is not inconclusive: tick "Extend anyway" to run a follow-up regardless.

probe.title: Fault test
probe.description: Re-run each arm under injected faults to see how it holds up.
probe.none: The suite declares no probes. Add probes to its suite.yaml, then come back.
probe.confirm: Start a probe sweep of {{expId}}? It spends model budget.

migrate.title: Compare models
migrate.description: Run one agent on its current model and on candidates, same tasks.
migrate.noAgents: No agents yet. Create one from a template first.
migrate.missing: Pick an agent and fill the suite, the current model and at least one candidate.
migrate.confirm: Start a model comparison? It spends model budget.

launch.title: Compare agents or models
launch.description: One agent across models on a suite.
